title: Item:Siberys Spirit Cake
wikitext:
__NOTOC__
{{Top}}
Returns target to life wherever accepted.

Depending on the version of the cake the target returns with half, full health, spell points, and can also return their nearby associated hirelings to life.

These cakes are Not usable in raids or public areas. 1 use.

Can not be mailed or auctioned.
